Additionally, we may use User’s IP addresses over time for anti-fraud detection and prevention. In addition, we may collect your Candidates Information (as defined below) which may include Personal Information. Additional information may be requested from time to time upon the then-current need. For avoidance of doubt, any Non-PII connected or linked to any Personal Information is deemed as Personal Information as long as such connection or linkage exists or possible. It should also be clarified that a User is not legally obligated to use the Website, or to disclose any information whatsoever to 4M. 3. How Do We Collect Information? 3.1. We may gather, collect and store the Personal Information either independently or through the help of our authorized third-party service providers, after we ensure that they meet industry security standards. 3.2. Information we automatically collect. We may also automatically collect certain technical data that is sent to us from the computer, mobile device and/or browser through which you access the Website.
